_comment: Which form reaches which list, board or template. Not secrets — ids and
mappings, kept here so adding a form is a reviewable diff rather than a
dashboard field nobody can see. Tokens and API keys stay in the environment.
Each key is an adapter name from src/lib/integrations/registry.ts, and each
section is that adapter's own vocabulary. An environment variable of the
matching name still wins, so one deployment can point somewhere else

fields._comment: Neutral field name -> ClickUp custom field id. Optional: every value already appears in the task description, so add one only to sort or filter the board by it. Keep 'relationship' a Text field, not a Dropdown. 'phone' stays empty on purpose: ClickUp's phone type demands E.164 and rejects the entire task for a local-format number, so wiring it would cost leads. Lead Source is left out on purpose: the field already defaults to Website in ClickUp.

lists._comment: Logical template name -> Brevo list id. Both are transactional audiences: people enter by asking for a report or sending an enquiry, not by opting in. Do not campaign to them.

templates._comment: Logical template name -> Brevo template id. Only read when MAILER=brevo-transactional.
